# Blackfield

A normal [markdown link](https://example.com/page) and a reference to
`[[not a wikilink in code]]` inside backticks is still converted, which the
README documents as a known limitation.

> A plain blockquote.

Percentages are safe: 50% done, 100% coverage.

> [!NOTE]
> Already GitHub-flavoured.
